keywords: Industrial dispute referred to arbitration prior to privatisation of the Petitioner company; arbitrator only relied upon evidence of a retired employee of the Petitioner and was paid gratuity from the Ceylon Petroleum Corporation Thrift Society. Held - on the face of the record, arbitrator erred in fact; Writ issued.
